business_summary.text: Metropolis Healthcare is a diagnostics chain with 209 laboratories and over 5,000 collection centres across 750 towns in India and five international markets, offering about 4,500 tests.

call_points.text: Medium-term revenue growth guidance kept at 14-15% without price increases; Q1FY27 delivered 17%.
Core Diagnostics, acquired at breakeven, is now at high single-digit EBITDA; guided to near company margins by year 3.
Working capital aspiration is single digit from double-digit today; capex to stay light.
International business is under 10% of revenue, self-funding with no capital from India.
Management said it has no clear blueprint yet for services beyond diagnostics and is a couple of quarters away.
1,500 more collection centres to take the lab-to-centre ratio to 1:35 from 1:24.
Gross margin gains came from lab platform consolidation, vendor consolidation and barcoding across 220 labs.
Board recommended an interim dividend of ₹1 per share.
Core Diagnostics reached a high-single-digit EBITDA margin in Q4FY26, meeting the four-quarter commitment.
No price increase was taken in Q4FY26 due to GST reasons; management will consider one later in the year if needed.
Intersegment eliminations will continue as Core Diagnostics products are sold through the MHL network.
Organic EBITDA margin reached 27.2% in Q4FY26 and 25.9% for FY26.
Acquired entities contributed 8% of FY26 group revenue.
FY26 carried a ₹9.0 Cr exceptional charge for the new labour code, cutting reported PAT.

operating_notes.text: NRC granted 2,12,345 options under the Metropolis ESOP Plan, 2025 at an exercise price of ₹375.62 per option, vesting over one to four years.
Q4FY26 organic patient volume 3.4 Mn (+9% YoY) and test volume 7.2 Mn (+9% YoY), with no price increase in the quarter.
Acquired entities (Core Diagnostics, DAPIC, Scientific Pathology, Ambika) contributed 8% of FY26 group revenue.
FY26 revenue per patient grew 6% YoY to ₹1,116 and revenue per test 5% to ₹531.
FY26 group patient volume grew 12% and test volume 13%; organic patient volume grew 7.5% and test volume 8%.
Network stood at over 5,000 collection centres, 212 labs and more than 750 towns; centre-to-lab ratio improved from 20:1 to 24:1.
Average productivity of own centres is ₹3.5-4 lakh per centre, rising from ₹1-1.5 lakh in year one to above ₹3 lakh by year three.
Metropolis has 209 laboratories and over 5,000 collection centres across 750 towns in India, with about 700-750 owned centres.
Specialty is about 40% of revenue and TruHealth close to 20%; B2C is 57% and B2B 43%.
International operations span five countries with 24 labs and contribute less than 10% of revenue.

timeline.summary: Metropolis Healthcare Limited will join Ambit Capital’s Q4FY26 earnings call on May 14, 2026, at 09:00 a.m. (IST) to discuss Q4 results ending March 31, 2026.
Metropolis Healthcare Limited scheduled an Analyst/Institutional Investor Meet with 360 ONE Capital on May 27, 2026, at 10:00 a.m. (IST) for one-on-one and group discussions.

On May 13, 2026, Metropolis Healthcare's Nomination and Remuneration Committee allotted 4,200 equity shares under the MHL-RSU Plan, 2020 and granted 14,236 RSU units and 2,12,345 ESOPs under its 2025 plans.

Metropolis Healthcare's Q4 & FY26 investor presentation (May 13, 2026) showed group revenue of ₹424.7 Cr (+23.0% YoY) and PAT of ₹51.0 Cr (+74.5%) for Q4FY26, with FY26 group revenue of ₹1,645.8 Cr (+23.6%).
Metropolis Healthcare reported Q4FY26 consolidated revenue of ₹424.7 Cr (+23.0% YoY) and PAT of ₹51.0 Cr (+74.5% YoY).
Metropolis Healthcare Limited hosted an earnings conference call on May 14, 2026, for Q4 FY26 results at 09:00 AM IST, with audio recording available on the company website.
On May 14, 2026, Metropolis Healthcare's Q4 & FY26 earnings call guided FY27-29 revenue CAGR of 14-15% and a group EBITDA margin of 27-28%, with 125-150 bps margin improvement in FY27.
Metropolis Healthcare Limited scheduled Analyst/Investor Meetings with Morgan Stanley India on June 03, 2026, and Choice Broking on June 11, 2026, at 10:00 a.m. (IST).
Metropolis Healthcare Limited scheduled an Analyst/Institutional Investor Meeting with Macquarie Healthcare on June 08, 2026, at 03:30 p.m. (IST) via virtual mode.

On 27 August 2026, Metropolis Healthcare held an investor and analyst meet where management maintained its 14-15% medium-term revenue growth guidance and set an EBITDA margin ambition of 27-28% from 24.4% in FY26.

watchlist.target: 27-28% over 3 years; 125-150 bps improvement in FY27

watchlist.response: Sameer Patel attributed the gap to intersegment eliminations of revenue and margin at consolidation, with the benefit sitting in organic margin.
watchlist.text: Analyst could not reconcile Core Diagnostics' high-single-digit margin with the 4-5% M&A margin implied by group minus organic numbers.

watchlist.response: Management said it is difficult to give one utilisation figure because labs are of different categories, and pointed to 14% productivity growth instead.
watchlist.text: Analyst asked for a single lab utilisation number.

watchlist.response: Ameera Shah said margins can expand with operating leverage but every few years the company will reinvest, and she would be happy with a steady-state margin close to current levels.
watchlist.text: Analyst asked for long-term operating margin profile given 78-80% gross margins and continued investment.

watchlist.response: Surendran Chemmenkotil gave per-centre capex of ₹35-40 lakh and said an opex model is also being evaluated, but gave no total capex or revenue target.
watchlist.text: Analyst asked for capex and revenue contribution from the 100 radiology mini hubs.

watchlist.response: Ameera Shah said there is no clear blueprint yet and the company is a couple of quarters away from deciding.
watchlist.text: Analyst asked whether the company would build a chain of clinics beyond diagnostics or just optimise real estate.
